scope.text_review: Exhaustive review of all 71 main steps and 34 remediation steps across six tiles, including prose, ledes, recap/up-next text, code examples, nested visual labels, annotations and alternative text. Assembled public lessons were also inspected for additional step content.
scope.interaction_sampling: Stratified sample of 13 of 37 interactions (35.1%), covering all six tiles and choice, code_exercise and classify formats. Reviewed sampled prompts, options/items, public workspace content, feedback and hints.

assessment: Applied blocked_future_concepts at the individual concept/step level, including later concepts within the same tile, rather than treating a whole multi-concept tile as already understood.

Iterator exhaustion/default behavior in the first iterator lesson and lazy processing in the generator-expression lesson are expressly taught by their own glossary facts; these do not require understanding the later dedicated lessons.
Up-next references introduce names/objectives only and do not require future-concept understanding.
Mentions of supplied checkers and checks do not require learners to understand unittest execution before it is taught. The sampled unittest-writing exercise explicitly says not to add a test runner.
Reviewing file deletion and withholding unverified dependencies are taught in their respective glossary concepts; their appearance before the final accept/correct/reject lesson is not leakage.

No needs-to-understand dependency on a blocked future concept was found in the exhaustive text review or sampled interactions. Unsampled interactions were not certified by this check. No deterministic gates were rerun and no generator reasoning or evaluator claims were used as evidence.
